Minimal preset preserves nav, footer, aside

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<nav>Navigation</nav><p>Content</p><footer>Footer</footer>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(preprocessing: HtmlToMarkdown::PreprocessingOptions.new(preset: 'Minimal')))
puts result.content.inspect
```
